newsitem.title: USA: PP&L to redeem mortgage bonds of $180 mln.
newsitem.headline: PP&L to redeem mortgage bonds of $180 mln.

text.p: Pennsylvania Power & Light Co said on Wednesday it plans to redeem four series of its first mortgage bonds on April 1, 1997.

The company said that three of the series of first mortgage bonds, which have a total principal amount of $180 million, would be redeemed under the maintenance and replacement fund provisions of the bonds.
The fourth series, having a principal amount of $30 million, would be redeemed under the optional redemption provisions.

Under the terms, the redemption prices would be 100.12 percent of the principal amount for the seven percent series bonds, 100.35 percent of the principal amount for the 7-1/4 percent series bonds, and 100.34 percent of the principal amount for the 7-1/2 percent series bonds, the company said.

The fourth series of bonds, consisting of $30 million principal amount of the 6 3/4 percent series bonds due Nov. 1, 1997, would be redeemed through the optional redemption provisions relating to that series, it said.
The optional redemption price will be 100.00 percent of the principal amount.
